answer_2.quote: Existing TTA methods adopt general evaluation metrics to assess the similarity between generated audio and reference audio, including Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Fréchet Distance (FD), Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) etc... We incorporate three widely used general evaluation metrics: the objective evaluation FAD, FD and KL divergence scores. ... we also propose multi-stage relation aware evaluation metrics (presence, relation correctness, audio parsimony, mAMSR).
automatic_metrics: Relation-aware metrics (presence, relation correctness, audio parsimony, mAMSR)
